principle: Book setup is a proposal-only preproduction design pass. It builds operational story, character, relationship, world and rolling-structure assets without writing manuscript prose or granting Canon authority.

book.setup_design.purpose: Turn an author brief and selected research/corpus mechanisms into a complete typed BookSetupArtifact for author approval before any chapter production.
rubric: Design a durable reader promise, premise, central conflict, progression and concrete fixed ending outcomes before local chapter planning. An ending question, alternative, theme label or empty future slot is not an ending.

Represent each core character as a decision engine: want, private need, false belief, fear or shame, values, mask, strategies, pressure leakage, defense or humor and relationship-sensitive voice. Do not return adjective-only profiles.
Represent each core relationship through shared history, hidden debt, power balance, forbidden topics and participant-specific tactics.
Keep world seeds sparse and pressure-bearing. Record rules and open unknowns instead of encyclopedic filler.
Create the first unit and chapter identity plus a 1-30 chapter rolling-outline horizon. Do not prewrite dialogue, scene prose or a five-million-character chapter list.

At five million characters or above, lock the full book and every volume from opening to ending: explicit volume plots and irreversible exits, cross-volume plot/relationship/romance/character arcs, one climax per volume, a concrete fixed ending, and visible character-charm proof beats. Empty volume slots or protected ending alternatives are invalid.

The rolling horizon may elaborate unit, chapter and scene execution only. Changing the approved book ending, volume spine, arc terminal states or climax chain requires a new setup fingerprint and explicit author approval.

Also prove scale with explicit per-volume capacity, multiple progression ladders, a three-zone rolling policy, cast evolution, repetition dimensions and selective evidence context. A numeric target alone is invalid.
minimum_total_characters is a scale intent and lower bound when supplied; never invent a maximum length.
The artifact is authority=false until an explicit book.setup.approve receipt binds it to the active DESIGN-BOOK plan.

source_evidence_refs.description: Exact author briefs, project files or research inputs used to derive this proposal. Every entry is revision- and SHA-256-bound; this is evidence provenance, not Canon authority.

long_form.description: Required by Core when minimum_total_characters is at least 5,000,000. Locks the full-book and per-volume story spine while leaving chapter and scene realization to rolling planning.
